title: Meeting the Bali bombing leader, who believed the Protocols

tellings.quote: >> so I mean this stuff is there. Uh I was met a terrorist the leader the guy who created the Bali bombings in 2002.

plain: Peter Levenda, an author who writes about secret history, says he met in Indonesia the man who led the 2002 Bali bombings, and that the man believed The Protocols of the Elders of Zion, a text that claims to reveal a Jewish plan for world domination. Levenda tells Michels this from his own experience, to show that such ideas are 'there' and still drive people to act.
